praise: Color restraint is genuinely on-brand: warm cream base, deep coffee-brown neutrals, a single gold accent — disciplined and unmistakably THIS shop, not gradient soup.
Fraunces + Inter pairing with tight tracking and a confident clamp() hero scale (2.2-4.2rem) gives strong display/body separation and clean rhythm.
Visual hierarchy lands correctly: name, then offer, then one clear primary CTA, with a real street address and tap-able phone repeated throughout.

Specific, believable copy — 'Beans dialed in daily', 'gone by noon', real 4.7/696 review data, concrete review quotes, and no lorem — plus thorough a11y hardening (tablist carousel, reduced-motion gating, focus-visible) elevate it well past template work.
